near_boot.meaning: Visible opaque boot sole edge in explicit boot ROI; no ground/shadow pixels.

far_boot.meaning: Visible opaque boot sole edge in explicit boot ROI; no ground/shadow pixels.

root_basis.interpretation: Use the near sole lower edge y464 and approximately centered two visible boot contacts. Far sole is 3px higher in this fixed3/4 image; do not force both feet onto one source Y.

frames.axis_evidence: Visible approximately horizontal curled-finger creases suggest a vertical held cylinder. The hidden cylinder and its directed blade end are not observable; this is a trial alignment estimate, not exact physical ground truth.
frames.polygon_basis: New manual trace from this retained original source-hand crop, covering the visible fist and black edge while excluding the cuff and belt. No old V007 polygon/root/marker reused. Approximate1-2px boundary; not a certified semantic mask.
frames.closed_finger_crease_visibility: Four curled-finger bands/creases are readable; no separate far hand overlaps this fist.
frames.thumb_status: Cannot independently isolate a thumb crossing the index/middle finger from these source pixels. Do not label thumb anatomy accepted.
frames.occlusion_status: Only an approximate whole visible near-fist replay polygon is proposed. It does not prove which hidden thumb/finger should cover a later weapon; require actual sword overlay review.
